description: Compound interest a buyer owes a micro or small enterprise on a delayed payment under s.16 MSMED Act (three times the RBI bank rate, compounded monthly), with the covered/not-covered verdict.

acceptance_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The day the buyer accepted the goods or services (delivery day if no objection was raised)

category.description: Supplier's MSME category at the time of the transaction

registered.description: When the supplier's Udyam registration was made, relative to the order

trader.description: Is the supplier a retail/wholesale trader (NIC 45/46/47)?
